source_audio.description: No audio was submitted and no request was issued: this frame is authored to Speechmatics' published Realtime protocol documentation, not captured from the service. The transcript is a fictional Spanish sentence authored for this repository ('El equipo revisó el informe esta mañana.'), written in the same style as the Spanish fixtures already committed to this tree; it names no real person, organisation, number, date or reference, and no voice — synthetic or otherwise — was involved.

redaction.notes: Nothing was redacted because nothing was captured. Every value is fictional by construction, including the speaker label, which identifies no real person.

terms.basis: docs/guides/provider-recording-protocol.md section 7 — no Output was captured at all; the fixture is authored to Speechmatics' published protocol documentation. Speechmatics STT's own verdict for a capture is permitted, and it is not what blocks one here (see notes)

source_schema.method: The documented field set, nesting, types and cardinality of the Realtime AddTranscript message were read from the page above, and the placement of the segment text was re-checked against the page's raw Markdown source at https://docs.speechmatics.com/api-ref/realtime-transcription-websocket.md because two readings of the rendered page disagreed on whether 'transcript' sits at the top level or inside 'metadata'. The raw source settles it: it is inside metadata, and that is how this frame carries it. The frame conforms to that schema: message, format, metadata (start_time, end_time, transcript), results[] (type, start_time, end_time, attaches_to, is_eos, volume, alternatives[]) and forced; each alternative carries content, confidence, language, display.direction, speaker and tags. The documented-optional 'channel' field is deliberately omitted — it appears only for multichannel sessions and its identifier form is not documented on that page, so carrying one would mean inventing a naming convention. No vendor example payload, prose or field description was copied into this repository — only the documented field names, the literal message-type constant 'AddTranscript', the documented enum members ('word', 'punctuation', 'previous', 'ltr') and the documented output-format version string, all of which are interface rather than expression. Every value is our own fiction.

notes: The final-transcript frame, and its last result is a punctuation element on purpose. Speechmatics documents results[] as a token stream where punctuation carries attaches_to 'previous', and it publishes the already-assembled segment text at metadata.transcript. SpeechmaticsSpeechRecognizer models neither: it ignores metadata entirely and rebuilds the string by joining results[*].alternatives[0].content with a single space, so this frame is the one that makes the resulting divergence visible — the SDK yields a space before the full stop that metadata.transcript does not have. That is a finding this fixture exists to expose, not a defect introduced here; no src/** file was touched. WHY THIS IS DOCUMENTATION-DERIVED RATHER THAN CAPTURED, and it is NOT a terms problem: section 7 of the protocol guide records Speechmatics STT as permitted — ToS section 10.3 assigns the customer all IP in Transcripts, which is the better-covered of the two directions — so the terms would have permitted a real capture of this frame. The reason there is no capture is simply that NO CAPTURE CREDENTIAL EXISTS IN THIS ENVIRONMENT. A real capture is therefore a known, cleared upgrade path for this provider the moment a credential appears: re-run section 3 of the guide in full and replace this file with a class 'recorded' one. What this artifact is worth, stated plainly: a documented schema is what the vendor says it sends, whereas a capture is what it actually sent on one day. This route closes the field-set and frame-ordering half of the ADR-0041 D4 gap and cannot close the does-the-vendor-honour-its-own-docs half. The page publishes no revision marker of its own — only the message-level 'format' version — so a silent breaking edit there is indistinguishable from no edit at all; re-read the source_schema URL first when this suite starts failing.
